message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: In Tianjin Baodi district, on Nov 7 2016, defendant Yang set fire to his ex-wife's property: corn husks, corn cobs in a steel shed, then went to main house and set fire to wardrobe clothes, causing fire, damage valued 17905 yuan. He voluntarily surrendered and confessed.

This is arson (放火) or intentional arson (故意放火). Chinese criminal law: Article 132 (放火罪) - "故意放火毁坏公私财物，情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑；情节特别严重的，处七年以上有期徒刑、无期徒刑或者死刑". So charge: 放火.

Also possibly "故意毁坏财物" (intentional damage to property) but arson is more specific. The examples earlier: For similar case of setting fire to house, they used "放火". Example: "武汉市汉阳区...因吸食毒品产生幻觉，用打火机将卧室内的被褥点燃... A: 放火". Another example: "吴某...点燃其家中三楼... A: 放火". So answer: 放火.

Thus single charge.
